comment: The section covers technical, structural, and semantic interoperability but gives limited attention to process or workflow interoperability. Correctly formatted and coded data may still be unusable if the receiving organisation cannot incorporate it into its operational workflow.

anchor.note: placed on the section, by a placement agent reading the comment against the text (high): Cites §1.2.2 lines 211-223 and Box 1.3 (several blocks).

public.text: The section covers technical, structural, and semantic interoperability but gives limited attention to process or workflow interoperability. Correctly formatted and coded data may still be unusable if the receiving organisation cannot incorporate it into its operational workflow.
public.suggestedRevision: Add organisational and workflow interoperability explicitly, including alignment of roles, processes, responsibilities, and operational responses to exchanged information.
